name: @wasm-gaming/sonic3air-wasm
description: Sonic 3 A.I.R. (Angel Island Revisited, by Eukaryot) for the web: the official WebAssembly build, pinned and checked, with a self-contained JS SDK implementing the wasm-gaming engine contract. The Sonic & Knuckles + Sonic 3 ROM is provided at runtime.
comment:scripts: Build logic lives in the Makefile, not here (make build / build-sdk / build-upstream / preview).
comment:dependencies: engine-specs is the one wasm-gaming package an engine depends on. Its runtime is also copied into dist/sonic3air/ and imported relatively, so the built SDK loads without a bundler or an import map; the dependency carries the types.
